build_autodoc_svelte: build svelte documentation for a python class with autodoc_svelte using object name and package
create_autodoc_markdown: create markdown documentation for a python module with autodoc_markdown and return anchors
resolve_links_in_text: resolve markdown links in text to internal documentation anchors using resolve_links_in_text
review_quality_check_docstring: review a python docstring for quality issues like empty return blocks or unclosed code blocks
find_object_in_package: find a python object by name inside a given package module with find_object_in_package
